title: Suppression of NNK Metabolism by Anthocyanin-Rich Haskap Berry Supplementation Through Modulation of P450 Enzymes.
authors: Amararathna, Madumani; Hoskin, David W; Goralski, Kerry B; Rupasinghe, H P Vasantha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究花青素补充剂通过调节P450酶抑制NNK代谢，含分子对接分析C3G与CYP2A5/CYP2A13的结合，但核心是代谢酶而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Oral supplementation of anthocyanins-rich haskap (Lonicera caerulea) berry (HB) reduces 4-(methylnitrosamino)-1-(3-pyridyl)-1-butanone (NNK)-induced lung tumorigenesis, cytotoxicity, DNA damage, and modulated inflammation in vitro and in vivo. The procarcinogen NNK is metabolically activated by cytochrome P450 (P450) enzymes, producing reactive metabolites that induce lung carcinogenesis. Hypothesis: Therefore, we hypothesized that the HB-modulated protective effect against NNK could be due to its ability to suppress P450 enzymes. Methods: HB (6 mg of cyanidin-3-O-glucoside [C3G] in 0.2 g of HB/mouse/day) was given to A/J mice as a dietary supplement following subsequent administration of NNK (100 mg/kg body weight). The liver tissues of mice were analyzed to determine the expression of P450s and metabolites. Results: HB upregulated the expression of cyp2a4 and cyp2a5 mRNA and nuclear receptor/transcription factor (PPARalpha) in NNK-deprived hepatic tissues. With NNK, HB downregulated the expression of cyp2a4 and cyp2a5 and facilitated the formation of non-carcinogenic NNK metabolites. Molecular docking indicated a high binding affinity and strong hydrophobic interactions between C3G and its major metabolites, peonidin-3-O-glucoside, petunidin-3-O-glucoside, peonidin and cyanidin with Cyp2a5 and with human P450 homologue CYP2A13. Conclusions: HB could be a potential dietary supplement to inhibit the P450 activated NNK carcinogenic metabolites formation. Hence, inhibiting the activation of NNK by lung CYP2A13 through dietary HB supplementation could be a strategy to reduce lung carcinogenesis among smokers. Understanding the effect of HB on the activity of CYP2A13 in human studies is necessary before recommending these natural compounds as therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 富含花青素的蓝靛果（Lonicera caerulea）浆果（HB）口服补充剂可减少4-(甲基亚硝胺基)-1-(3-吡啶基)-1-丁酮（NNK）诱导的肺肿瘤发生、细胞毒性、DNA损伤，并在体外和体内调节炎症。前致癌物NNK通过细胞色素P450（P450）酶代谢活化，产生诱导肺癌发生的活性代谢物。假设：因此，我们假设HB对NNK的保护作用可能归因于其抑制P450酶的能力。方法：将HB（每只小鼠每天0.2 g HB中含6 mg的矢车菊素-3-O-葡萄糖苷[C3G]）作为膳食补充剂给予A/J小鼠，随后给予NNK（100 mg/kg体重）。分析小鼠肝组织以确定P450s及其代谢物的表达。结果：在未接触NNK的肝组织中，HB上调了cyp2a4和cyp2a5 mRNA及核受体/转录因子（PPARalpha）的表达。在存在NNK的情况下，HB下调了cyp2a4和cyp2a5的表达，并促进了非致癌性NNK代谢物的形成。分子对接表明，C3G及其主要代谢物芍药素-3-O-葡萄糖苷、矮牵牛素-3-O-葡萄糖苷、芍药素和矢车菊素与Cyp2a5及人P450同源物CYP2A13之间具有高结合亲和力和强疏水相互作用。结论：HB可能是一种潜在的膳食补充剂，用于抑制P450活化的NNK致癌代谢物的形成。因此，通过膳食补充HB抑制肺部CYP2A13对NNK的活化，可能是减少吸烟者肺癌发生的一种策略。在推荐这些天然化合物作为治疗药物之前，有必要在人体研究中了解HB对CYP2A13活性的影响。
